notes.title: Out Now
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

"Karin's Instruction" is out now!

Exciting and interesting game content,
Six fulfilling plots and H feast,
Take it home quickly and have close contact with Karin.

notes.title: Demo available for a limited time
notes.content:
Hello everyone

Demo of "Karin's Instruction" is now available..
Want to be the first to get up close and personal with Karin?
Download the Demo and play now! !

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698230/_/

The demo will close in about a week.

notes.title: Release date!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone

"Karin's Instruction" will be released on 2024/2/12 AM 9:00 AM (PST).
Is it starting to feel unbearable with less than a month left? The anticipation must be building up!

We understand everyone's excitement, 
so we've prepared a demo version that will be available a few days before the official release. 
This will allow everyone to experience Karin's private charm in a more intimate way.

Stay tuned!
